data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts.
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations.

features.title: Display Real-Time Metrics with Chart.js
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to display LLM cost, stage completion rates, and success rate trends.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost is shown over time with a line chart.
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features and Metrics
features.description: Highlight Artemis features such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning with charts.
acceptance_criteria: Features are clearly presented with supporting charts.
Charts accurately represent feature metrics.
Content is informative and engaging.

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Incorporate actual data from recent Artemis runs to demonstrate system performance.
acceptance_criteria: Real metrics are integrated into the presentation.
Data is accurate and up-to-date.
Metrics enhance the credibility of the demo.

features.title: Highlight Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Showcase code quality compliance with TDD and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance metrics.
SOLID principles are represented in the chart.
Chart provides a clear overview of code quality.

features.title: Enhance with Chart.js Animations and Interactivity
features.description: Make the presentation visually impressive with animations and interactive elements using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Charts include smooth animations.
Interactive elements enhance user engagement.
Animations do not detract from the presentation's clarity.

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls for manual progression.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Navigation controls allow manual slide progression.
Controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included and functional within the HTML.

features.title: Utilize Existing Demos as Templates
features.description: Leverage existing demo files as templates for creating the new Artemis self-demo presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Templates from specified directory are used as a base.
Key elements from templates are adapted for the new demo.
Demo maintains a consistent style with existing templates.

features.title: Illustrate Supervisor Integration
features.description: Demonstrate supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration.
Chart is clear and easy to interpret.
Integration details are effectively communicated.

features.title: Design Professional Background and Transitions
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions between slides.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is visually appealing and consistent.
Slide transitions are smooth and professional.
Overall presentation maintains a polished look.
